in_marathi.name: Ajay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Not a God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajay in Sanskrit is derived from the word ‘an-a-jaya’, which means 'not a god'. It is a common name in Hindu culture and is often used for boys.
